picks.title: Pages, Keynote, Numbers just added powerful new AI features
picks.rationale: New release: Apple's iWork suite ships AI updates, including a new 'Intelligent Assistant' in Pages, Keynote and Numbers, so the AI is on by default in tools designers use for decks and docs.
picks.excerpt: Apple is rolling out AI-centric updates to its iWork suite—Pages, Keynote, Numbers—that include a brand new ‘Intelligent Assistant.’

picks.title: Microsoft pulls eight Copilot actions from Windows 11 File Explorer
picks.rationale: Concrete retirement: Microsoft is removing eight Copilot right-click actions (Summarize, Compare Files, Extract text) from mid-November to early December. Ask Copilot stays, and the actions move to the OneDrive activity center.
picks.excerpt: Microsoft is removing eight Copilot actions from the right-click menu for OneDrive files in Windows 11, including Summarize, Compare Files and Extract text. The retirement starts in mid-November and should be complete by early December. Ask Copilot stays in the menu, and the individual actions remain available in the OneDrive activity center.

picks.title: Timekettle expands offline translation for W4 earbuds with 12 new language pairs
picks.rationale: New software release: a firmware update adds 12 offline language pairs to the existing W4 Pro and W4 Plus AI translation earbuds, so on-device translation now works without Wi-Fi or mobile data for more language combinations.
picks.excerpt: Timekettle's translation earbuds are getting a little more multilingual. A new software update adds 12 offline language pairs to the existing W4 Pro and W4 Plus models, making them more useful when Wi-Fi and mobile data decide to disappear at the worst possible moment.

picks.title: AI can describe a picture, but it still struggles to understand blind users
picks.rationale: New research: a University of Maryland study finds Be My AI gives blind users long descriptions when they need specific visual facts. It is a direct lesson for designing AI assistive interfaces.
picks.excerpt: A University of Maryland study finds that Be My AI often gives blind users lengthy answers instead of the specific visual information they need.

picks.title: 'Literally never in my life wanted a tool like Recall or this version of it': Windows 11 has a reined-in alternative to Recall in testing, but some people still hate the idea
picks.rationale: New feature in testing: Windows 11's 'Context Vault' is a scaled-back alternative to Recall's AI memory. Together with the Copilot pullback, it shows Microsoft reworking on-device AI after user pushback.
picks.excerpt: A classic case of 'solving a problem that doesn't exist': Windows 11 could get an alternative to Recall, but AI skeptics still aren't fans.

The 10-06 card covered the rollout of these actions; this one covers their withdrawal.
